review.why: Polish surfaces and icons with exact values for concentric radius, optical alignment, layered shadows, image outlines and icon states.
review.summary: A small, precise polish skill: outer radius equals inner radius plus padding, optical nudges for icons and play triangles, layered shadow rings with a transparent border for forced-colors, pure black or white image outlines, hover only on hover-capable pointers, overscroll containment and stroke weight matched to text.
strengths: Exact, copyable values: shadow layers for light and dark, image outline colors, the radius formula.
Catches details others miss: stuck hover on touch, tinted image outlines, forced-colors dropping box-shadow.
Clear boundaries: leaves hit areas, color tokens and animation to sibling skills.
cautions: Narrow scope (surfaces and icons); it assumes the interaction is already sound.
Some values are taste choices (shadow opacities, image outline 0.1) even though they are stated as exact.
SKILL.md and surfaces reference read in full, icons by headings; not run here.
